name: Diverse Music
description: Users want a more extensive music library with less repetitive recommendations to discover new artists and songs. This need is evident from reviews mentioning the lack of variety in song recommendations and the repetition of the same songs.

name: Intuitive Discovery
description: Users need a simpler and more intuitive user interface for music discovery, allowing them to easily find and explore new music. Reviews highlight the complexity and clutter of the current UI, making it hard to discover new music.

name: Personalized Playlists
description: Users desire personalized music recommendations that cater to their tastes and preferences, reducing repetitive listening behavior. Reviews express frustration with the current recommendation algorithm, which often suggests the same songs or artists repeatedly.

name: Social Music Sharing
description: Users want an intuitive music sharing feature with social discovery capabilities, enabling them to share and discover music with friends easily. Reviews suggest that the current sharing process is clunky and manual, hindering social music discovery.

name: Transparent Recommendations
description: Users want to understand why certain songs are recommended to them, seeking transparency in the recommendation algorithm. Reviews indicate that users are often puzzled by the repetitive or irrelevant song suggestions, highlighting the need for more transparent recommendation reasoning.
